examples.label: Numbered how-it-works steps
examples.source:
1
<.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-4">Point your domain <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Add one CNAME record. The certificate is issued for you within a minute.
2
<.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-4">Build the page <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Drag blocks onto the canvas and edit their text straight where it sits.
3
<.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-4">Publish <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Your change is live immediately, with the previous version kept as a draft.
